data.translation:
The Central Jakarta Timur District Court has granted the objection filed by dr. Tifauzia Tyassuma, alias dr. Tifa, in the case of alleged defamation and slander related to accusations of a fake diploma against the 7th President of the Republic of Indonesia, Joko Widodo. With this interim decision, the prosecutor's indictment is declared legally null and void, so the trial cannot proceed.

"Ruling. Declaring the objection from the defendant's legal team accepted. Declaring the Public Prosecutor's Indictment Number Register Case PDM-133/M.1.14/EOH.06/2026 dated June 22, 2026, in the name of the defendant dr. Tifa Fauziyah Suma, legally null and void," stated the panel of judges while reading the interim decision at the Central Jakarta Timur District Court, Thursday (23/7).

The panel of judges assessed that the prosecutor was not thorough in drafting the indictment because it used articles from two different legal regimes, namely the new Criminal Code and the old Criminal Code, to charge the same act. According to the judge, this instead creates legal uncertainty.

"The doubt in determining the charged article shows that the public prosecutor was not thorough in drafting the indictment," said the judge.

Based on these considerations, the judge ordered that the case file along with the evidence be returned to the public prosecutor. Thus, the examination of the case against dr. Tifa does not proceed to the trial stage.

📸: Dok. Antara.

result.text:
Pengadilan Negeri Jakarta Timur mengabulkan perlawanan yang diajukan dr Tifauzia Tyassuma alias dr Tifa dalam perkara dugaan fitnah dan pencemaran nama baik terkait tudingan ijazah palsu Presiden ke-7 RI Joko Widodo. Dengan putusan sela tersebut, surat dakwaan jaksa dinyatakan batal demi hukum sehingga persidangan tidak dapat dilanjutkan.

"Mengadili. Menyatakan perlawanan dari tim advokat terdakwa diterima. Menyatakan Surat Dakwaan Penuntut Umum Nomor Register Perkara PDM-133/M.1.14/EOH.06/2026 tanggal 22 Juni 2026 atas nama terdakwa dr. Tifa Fauziyah Suma batal demi hukum," ujar majelis hakim saat membacakan putusan sela di PN Jakarta Timur, Kamis (23/7).

Majelis hakim menilai jaksa tidak cermat dalam menyusun dakwaan karena menggunakan pasal dari dua rezim hukum yang berbeda, yakni KUHP baru dan KUHP lama, untuk mendakwa perbuatan yang sama. Menurut hakim, hal tersebut justru menimbulkan ketidakpastian hukum.

"Keragu-raguan dalam menentukan pasal yang didakwakan menunjukkan penuntut umum tidak cermat dalam menyusun surat dakwaan," kata hakim.

Atas dasar pertimbangan tersebut, hakim memerintahkan agar berkas perkara beserta barang bukti dikembalikan kepada penuntut umum. Dengan demikian, pemeriksaan perkara terhadap dr Tifa tidak berlanjut pada tahap persidangan.

📸: Dok. Antara.
